body.name: Occupancy-weighted second-order score
body.construction: Partition the side-\(h\) cube around \(x_0\) into \(k\asymp h^d/\ell^d\) public cells \(C_j\) of mass \(v\asymp\ell^d\). For a bounded symmetric kernel \(Z_{\mathrm{pair}}\), form the within-cell ordered-pair average \(B_j\) and set \(S_{\mathrm{occ}}=\sum_{j=1}^kN_jB_j\), with \(B_j=0\) if \(N_j<2\).
